about: Identifier hits already public on main before 2.14.2 (staff logins and names, old submission numbers), as KEYS only, never their text: each is tests/identifier_rules.baseline_key(path, line) -- the sha256 of '<path>\0<line>', the path relative to the skill with '/', the line stripped (a file or folder name: the name). tests/test_no_new_identifiers.py fails on any hit whose key is not here, or that occurs more often than its count; a client name is never excused. Never add to it: it only shrinks. The 2.15 slim-down deletes it.
